description: Read the latest retest summary for up to 200 finding IDs. Requires read permission and the organisation's retest capability; never starts a retest or spends credits. Missing entries have no latest retest.

findingIds.description: Up to 200 internal finding IDs from list_findings. Human identifiers are not accepted by these batch endpoints.
